description: This file defines the AppRouter class responsible for handling route generation within a Flutter application. It manages navigation by mapping route names to corresponding screen widgets.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Manages routing within the Flutter app, generating routes based on route names and optional arguments.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Generates a route based on the provided RouteSettings, returning appropriate screens or a default 'Not found' page.

methods.name: _material
methods.description: Helper method to create a MaterialPageRoute for a given widget.
